relations: If an upright domino in a serpentine row falls, the next adjacent upright domino topples in sequence.
As the wave advances, fallen dominoes lie diagonally while farther upright segments remain vertical.
The rainbow piles behind remain stationary while foreground rows show progressive flattening.
The white cord, transparent ruler, and white rows persist unchanged under fixed framing.
caption:
The video showcases a fixed high-angle view of a light wood floor arranged with dominoes. The upper half holds a fan-shaped spread of piles sorted into rainbow bands—purple, dark blue, light blue, green, yellow, orange, red, and pink—ringed by scattered loose pieces. A white braided cord rests at the far left, a transparent ruler lies horizontally across the middle, and short rows of white dominoes sit on the right, while several long serpentine lines of upright multicolored dominoes weave across the lower half.
Within these foreground lines, a toppling wave is already underway and continues to advance during the clip. Sections that stand as neat vertical zigzags gradually flatten into diagonal, lying-down pieces, so the upright and fallen segments shift position along the wavy rows over time. The serpentine rows show this upright-to-flat transition creeping along their lengths. Meanwhile, the large rainbow piles behind them appear undisturbed in place, while the cord, ruler, and white rows remain visually unchanged under the still camera framing.
